review_notes:
I read the whole file and checked each new definition and structure against the rubric. These were CopyFamily and its copy/term/periodized/sum, RegularFamily, SupportCells, LocalStrippedClass, CommonChart, copyBandDomain, CarrierBounds, nativeCenter, nativeSupportCells, nativeCutoffSupportCells and vectorSum. All of them are specific to this development: they build on the local WaveFamily, CarrierData, Cells and PhaseJetBounds.Domain types. I know of no Mathlib structure for periodized oscillatory carrier families, native-cell support records or physical-class jet records. Nothing here is a competing version of a Mathlib concept.
- The private lemma `nat_le_infty` and the germ lemmas are standalone theorem-level facts, which the rubric excludes.
- `vectorSum` is a sum of real coordinates through the local `realCoordinate`. I did not find a Mathlib concept it would replace, and it is a named, purpose-specific API.
- `copyBandDomain` only instantiates the existing `PhaseJetBounds.Domain` structure, so it is not a duplicate.
I did not search Mathlib exhaustively, so there is some uncertainty about niche overlaps. I found no case where consolidation would clearly pay off.
